title: Predicting VO2peak from Submaximal- and Peak Exercise Models: The HUNT 3 Fitness Study, Norway

keyFinding.enGB: Population fitness models from HUNT support estimating VO2peak for wellness fitness comparisons when direct CPET is unavailable.
